title: sdks-auth-retries-streaming-ergonomics-parity-v1.171.0
author: Camila Ortiz
description: Unify SDK auth token handling, standardize retry/backoff policies, and improve streaming ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. Motivation: different SDKs had subtle behavioral differences in refresh timing and streaming interfaces which caused parity issues for customers using multi-language integrations and increased support load. This PR centralizes auth token refresh logic into a shared core for each SDK, introduces a configurable RetryPolicy with exponential backoff + jitter and idempotency-aware defaults, and updates streaming APIs to a more ergonomic shape (async iterator for Python, event-emitter and async iterable parity for TypeScript, and a channel-based iterator for Go). Also includes small API ergonomics fixes (typed errors, consistent context/cancellation handling), alignment tests, documentation updates, and version bumps to v1.171.0 for all three SDKs. Checklist: - [x] Core auth plumbing implemented and covered by unit tests. - [x] Retry policy implemented and applied to network calls. - [x] Streaming API ergonomics implemented and docs/examples updated. - [x] Parity tests and cross-language examples added. - [x] Version bumps and changelogs prepared.
